about: How a space's share sheet makes it open to everyone (src/space-open.mjs; the share sheet src/workspace/sharing-sheet.tsx SpaceSharing, Who else can open it). A space is open to everyone when its own rules let anyone read it (src/community.mjs openToEveryone), and then it shows in Open to you for everyone. Opening it adds `allow` to the space's rules and adds `actions` to the exception list of every deny rule named in `denies` (the rule each space starts with that keeps outsiders out), because a deny that holds always wins; closing takes both away. `shown_only` are the words a rules read adds to each rule for people (src/space-permissions.mjs coverOf), left out when the rules are saved again. Nothing here is code: another way of opening a space is another row.
